verdict.rationale: Scoping a remote session to view-only, control, clipboard or file access is a fair question for a remote-access tool like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents such per-connection permission controls. The pack only covers centrally managed devices, SSO, audit logs and remote scripting, which are adjacent features rather than session permission scoping.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
